title: MES Discrete Manufacturing - Injected Bug Benchmark

bugs.description: Operator role can create products with unit_cost field. Should be restricted to PLANNER/MANAGER/ADMIN only.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 403 Forbidden when OPERATOR attempts to create a product
bugs.actual_behavior: Product created successfully with 201

bugs.description: No role restriction on unit_cost modification. Any authenticated user can change product cost. Should be MANAGER/ADMIN only.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 403 when PLANNER/OPERATOR/INSPECTOR/WAREHOUSE modifies unit_cost
bugs.actual_behavior: Cost updated successfully

bugs.description: OPERATOR and PLANNER roles can delete work orders. Should be MANAGER/ADMIN only.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 403 for OPERATOR and PLANNER
bugs.actual_behavior: Work order deleted successfully

bugs.description: No factory scope check on work report creation. Operator from fac-002 can report on fac-001 work orders.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 403 when operator.factory != work_order.factory
bugs.actual_behavior: Work report created regardless of factory mismatch

bugs.description: Work centers from all organizations are visible to any authenticated user. Should filter by user's org.
bugs.expected_behavior: acme user sees only acme work centers (wc-001~004)
bugs.actual_behavior: All 5 work centers returned regardless of org

bugs.description: No organization check when viewing a specific work order. Users from globex can view acme work orders.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 403/404 when user.org != work_order.org (unless ADMIN)
bugs.actual_behavior: Work order details returned to any authenticated user

bugs.description: Work order can be closed directly from IN_PRODUCTION status, skipping COMPLETED state.
bugs.expected_behavior: Only COMPLETED work orders can be closed
bugs.actual_behavior: IN_PRODUCTION work orders can also be closed

bugs.description: No validation that planned_start < planned_end when creating work orders.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 400 if planned_start >= planned_end
bugs.actual_behavior: Work order created with invalid date range

bugs.description: Confirmed production plans can still be modified. Should be immutable after confirmation.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 when modifying a CONFIRMED plan
bugs.actual_behavior: Plan modified successfully

bugs.description: COMPLETED work orders can be released again. Release should only work from CREATED status.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 for non-CREATED work orders
bugs.actual_behavior: COMPLETED/IN_PRODUCTION orders can be released

reproduction.precondition: wo-001 must be COMPLETED or IN_PRODUCTION

bugs.description: No check that work order is COMPLETED before creating receipt. Receipts can be created for any WO status.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if work_order.status != COMPLETED
bugs.actual_behavior: Receipt created for CREATED/RELEASED/IN_PRODUCTION work orders

bugs.description: Quality inspections from all organizations are visible. Should filter by user's org.
bugs.expected_behavior: Only return inspections belonging to user's org
bugs.actual_behavior: All inspections returned regardless of org

bugs.description: No validation that referenced BOM and Routing exist and are ACTIVE. Can create WO with invalid bom_id/routing_id.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 400/404 if BOM or Routing doesn't exist or is not ACTIVE
bugs.actual_behavior: Work order created with non-existent BOM/Routing references

bugs.description: No check that all material reservations are RESERVED before starting work order.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if any reservation is not in RESERVED status
bugs.actual_behavior: Work order started regardless of reservation status

bugs.description: No check that all operations are COMPLETED before completing work order.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if any operation is not COMPLETED
bugs.actual_behavior: Work order completed with PENDING/IN_PROGRESS operations

bugs.description: No check that referenced inspection has result=REJECT. Rework can be created for PASS inspections.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if inspection.result != REJECT
bugs.actual_behavior: Rework order created for any inspection

bugs.description: No check that work order planned_quantity doesn't exceed remaining production plan quantity.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if planned_quantity > plan.planned_quantity - existing WO quantities
bugs.actual_behavior: Unlimited work orders can be created against a plan

bugs.description: No check for quality inspection PASS before creating receipt.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if no PASS inspection exists for the work order
bugs.actual_behavior: Receipt created without any quality inspection

bugs.description: No validation that issue quantity <= reserved_quantity - already_issued. Can over-issue materials.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if quantity > reservation.reserved_quantity - reservation.issued_quantity
bugs.actual_behavior: Any quantity can be issued

bugs.description: No validation that reported quantity doesn't exceed work order planned_quantity minus previously reported.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if cumulative reported > planned_quantity
bugs.actual_behavior: Unlimited quantity can be reported

bugs.description: No validation that pass_quantity + fail_quantity = sample_size. Sum can exceed or be less than sample_size.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 400 if pass_quantity + fail_quantity != sample_size
bugs.actual_behavior: Any values accepted

bugs.description: Work order completed_quantity is not updated when receipt is confirmed.
bugs.expected_behavior: work_order.completed_quantity += receipt.quantity on confirm
bugs.actual_behavior: completed_quantity remains 0

bugs.description: No duplicate check on order_ref. Same order_ref can create multiple sales orders.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 Conflict for duplicate order_ref
bugs.actual_behavior: Multiple sales orders with same order_ref created

bugs.description: No duplicate receipt check per work_order_id. Multiple receipts can be created for same WO.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 Conflict if receipt already exists for work_order_id
bugs.actual_behavior: Multiple receipts created for same work order

bugs.description: Cancelling a work order does not release associated material reservations.
bugs.expected_behavior: All material reservations for the WO should be set to RELEASED status
bugs.actual_behavior: Reservations remain in RESERVED status after WO cancellation

bugs.description: Deleting a BOM does not cascade-delete its BOM lines, leaving orphan records.
bugs.expected_behavior: All BOM lines with bom_id should be deleted
bugs.actual_behavior: BOM deleted but BOM lines remain as orphans

bugs.description: No expiry_date check when submitting inspection. Expired inspections can still be submitted.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if current date > expiry_date
bugs.actual_behavior: Expired inspections submitted successfully

bugs.description: Sales order delivery_date can be modified after linked production plan is CONFIRMED.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if a CONFIRMED production plan references this sales order
bugs.actual_behavior: delivery_date modified freely

reproduction.precondition: pp-001 references so-001 and is CONFIRMED

bugs.description: No optimistic locking version check on work order updates. Concurrent modifications cause lost updates.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if provided version != stored version
bugs.actual_behavior: Updates applied regardless of version mismatch

bugs.description: No version check on material return. Concurrent returns can cause double-return.
bugs.expected_behavior: Return 409 if version mismatch (prevent double-return)
bugs.actual_behavior: Return processed without version verification

bugs.description: Partial failure in bulk release is not rolled back. Successfully released orders stay released even if later ones fail.
bugs.expected_behavior: All-or-nothing: if any WO fails, all previously released in batch roll back
bugs.actual_behavior: Successful releases persist despite later failures

reproduction.note: wo-002 is CREATED (succeeds), wo-001 is RELEASED (fails)

bugs.description: Bulk material issue has no atomicity. All items are created without validation; invalid items are not rejected.
bugs.expected_behavior: Atomic: if any item fails validation, none should be created
bugs.actual_behavior: All items created regardless of validity

notes: All bugs are behavioral - no syntax errors or crashes
Bugs require understanding business rules to detect
